how: We read the website of every Charleston wedding photographer listed on Lazo (99 listings, 69 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: family, senior and maternity portrait studios, an Atlanta studio and a multi-state team with a Charleston landing page, a multi-service chain, and officiants. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How do you handle midday sun and summer humidity on the peninsula, and where do you take portraits if a storm rolls through?
Is a second shooter included, and can I see a full gallery from a wedding at a venue like mine, not a highlight reel?
What is the delivery timeline, and do you offer film, digital or both?

picks.name: Charleston Photo Art
tags: photo and video in every collection
picks.blurb: Dennis Aliaksandrou founded Charleston Photo Art in 2016 and brings a master's degree in psychology to connecting with people on the day. The Mt Pleasant team includes photo and cinematic video in every collection and publishes a page on what wedding photography and video cost in Charleston.

picks.name: Nicholas Gore Weddings
picks.blurb: Over 15 years and more than 750 weddings, Nick Gore has built a reputation for iconic portraits with an easygoing, relaxed working style. Editorial wedding photography with emotion, for couples who want beautiful photos without the day feeling like a photoshoot.

picks.name: Dana Cubbage Weddings
picks.blurb: Dana Cubbage is a Charleston-based destination wedding photographer drawn to light, color and the joy of celebrations big and small. She pairs a strong head for logistics with storytelling, and says the greatest gift she can give couples is presence and unrushed time with family.

picks.name: Taylor Jordan Photography
picks.blurb: Taylor and her team shoot a hybrid of film and digital for contemporary couples, with medium format film alongside digital. Luxury wedding photography in Charleston, Palm Beach and New York, and the site says it was voted Charleston's best wedding photographer in 2024 and 2025.

picks.name: King Street Photo Weddings
picks.blurb: Michel Berda has photographed Charleston weddings since 1999 in a documentary, artful luxury style, with destination work as well. The site is built on couples' own words, describing him as personal, outgoing and honest, and someone who runs a tight ship.

picks.name: The Smith Brian
picks.blurb: The Smith Brian shoots weddings on film, documentary style, with an eye for editorial posing and composition. A former engineer who turned a hobby into a career, specializing in destination weddings and editorial portraiture both in studio and on location.

picks.name: Franzi Annika Photography
picks.blurb: Franzi and Martin met in Germany, eloped six months into dating, and now blend fine art, fashion and photojournalism for Charleston weddings and elopements. The North Charleston pair post a pricing page and wedding guides, and push printed albums over photos that live on a phone.

picks.name: Aaron and Jillian Photography
picks.blurb: Aaron and Jill are a husband-and-wife duo with 12 years of wedding experience, based in Charleston and available worldwide. They met in 2009 teaching English in South Korea, where early dates meant photographing markets and coastlines together.

picks.name: Valerie & Ed Photo
picks.blurb: Valerie and Ed Brantley are two pros with one purpose: wedding documentation designed around you, in a classic and timeless style. Working as a married team, they say, means fewer miscommunications and more captured moments.

picks.name: Faith Roper Photography
picks.blurb: Faith Roper started in a college darkroom and still shoots both film and digital, with the classic look of film shaping her style. Romantic, artful work inspired by natural light, classical paintings and historic architecture, in Charleston and at destinations worldwide.

picks.name: Susan DeLoach Photography
picks.blurb: Susan DeLoach is a professional wedding photographer based in Beaufort, in the Sea Island landscape of salt marshes, live oaks and winding creeks. Her site shows real weddings by couple and venue, from Agape Oaks to St. Peter's Catholic Church with a Fripp Island reception.

picks.name: Cushla Beasley Wedding Photography
picks.blurb: Cushla Beasley moved to the United States from Auckland and treats a wedding from the stationery styling through the grand exit lighting. She prints her pricing: Weekend Coverage is $14,100 with unlimited hours on the wedding day plus three hours at the rehearsal dinner or welcome party.
